Subject: Re: Deep integration scoping + GTS qualification for CloudForge connector — tech notes

Ben / Olga / Avery —

High-level tech readout after a quick pass on the spec:
- SKU-based usage events: straightforward. We can add an event emitter that tags tokens/requests with marketplace SKU metadata; estimate ~2 dev tickets (backend + router) and 1 QA ticket.
- Prefix-level caching: this will need an adapter extension. If we expose an adapter flag to enable prefix-KV mode it is doable but will require careful KV eviction tests (to avoid cross-tenant leakage). Estimate: 3 sprints (2 dev + 1 test) if prioritized.
- Streaming/latency considerations: we’ll need to validate memory/KV hot-paths for the streaming connector to ensure tail latencies remain <100ms for targeted SKUs.

Needs from CloudForge to start:
- Test AWS/GCP account with sample dataset and a service principal we can use for auth testing.
- A list of required metering events and expected SKU mapping (we can prototype with three SKUs).

I attached a rough integration test plan (integration-test-plan.md) and a short checklist of infra tickets I’ll open once we confirm scope. If we want to hit a Q3 launch we need to kick off immediately and reserve a mid-size engineering runway (6 weeks).

--Connor
